title: A sheaf on an affine inverse limit is a colimit
statement:
Let $X=\varprojlim_iX_i$ be a directed inverse limit of affine schemes with
affine transition maps, and write $p_i:X\to X_i$. For every torsion abelian
sheaf $F$ on $X_{\Et}$, the sheaves $p_{i,*}F$, with their
canonical transition maps, form a compatible system and the canonical
morphism

$$
\varinjlim_ip_i^{-1}p_{i,*}F\longrightarrow F
$$

is an isomorphism. (*Source:* Stacks Project,
[Tag
`0EYN`](https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0EYN).) In the Stacks Project this is a special case of Sites, Lemma 7.18.5,
[Tag `0EXJ`](https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0EXJ), via
Lemma 59.51.2, [Tag
`0EYL`](https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0EYL) (the affine etale site of an affine limit is the colimit
of the affine etale sites of the stages). The first step of that reduction,
the descent of finitely presented algebras along the colimit of rings, is proved
in this chapter as [lem-kun-fp-algebra-descent].
The affine and torsion case recorded here is the one used in this chapter.

proof.text: The identity law follows by applying the inverse-image adjunction hom equivalence to the defining adjoint transpose, then using the identity law for lower-star composition and the identity upper-star comparison.

For two composable arrows, apply the adjunction hom equivalence to both sides. The pasted hom equivalence calculation reduces the claim to associativity of lower-star composition, namely the coherence lemma lowerStarComp_assoc'.

Affine stages are quasi-compact and quasi-separated by the affine-scheme instances. The pull-push transition is equal to the approximation diagram transition by the same pasted adjunction calculation. Reindex the approximation diagram along the opposite-category equivalence; the final-functor colimit equivalence transports the existing affine-limit sheaf reconstruction theorem to a colimit cocone indexed by I.

Reused the existing qcqs affine-site colimit, affine-site equivalence, and abelian section formula, rather than creating duplicates or a general restatement of the item. Constructed the counit transitions, checked their cocycle and the actual map on sections, and proved it is the constant-diagram colimit isomorphism. Statement unchanged. No new nodes. Second reading expanded the restriction comparisons and pasted-counit equalities, and used the constant-diagram universal property directly. Return repair: reread all current cited statements and the Stacks source; retained the equivalence clause of the extended affine-site comparison and made the filtered-tail indexing explicit in step 5.

Identifies the geometric inverse images for composites, preserving their adjunction units; used to specify the canonical transition maps.

lean.statement: theorem kun_descent_limit (I : Type u) [Preorder I] [Nonempty I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)] (X : Iᵒᵖ ⥤ Scheme.{u}) (hX : ∀ i : Iᵒᵖ, IsAffine (X.obj i)) (htransition : ∀ {i j : Iᵒᵖ} (f : i ⟶ j), IsAffineHom (X.map f)) (c : Cone X) (hc : IsLimit c) (F : Sheaf c.pt.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (hF : CategoryTheory.Sheaf.IsTorsion F) : (∀ i : I, kunDescentStageTransition X c F (𝟙 i) = eqToHom (congrArg (fun a : X.obj (op i) ⟶ X.obj (op i) ↦ (Etale.upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} a).obj ((Etale.lowerStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (c.π.app (op i))).obj F)) (X.map_id (op i))) ≫ (Etale.upperStarId AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (X.obj (op i))).hom.app ((Etale.lowerStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (c.π.app (op i))).obj F)) ∧ (∀ {i j k : I} (f : i ⟶ j) (g : j ⟶ k), kunDescentStageTransition X c F (f ≫ g) = (Etale.upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (X.map g.op) (X.map f.op) (X.map (f ≫ g).op) (X.map_comp g.op f.op)).hom.app ((Etale.lowerStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (c.π.app (op i))).obj F) ≫ (Etale.upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (X.map g.op)).map (kunDescentStageTransition X c F f) ≫ kunDescentStageTransition X c F g) ∧ ∃ (D : I ⥤ Sheaf c.pt.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (e : ∀ i : I, D.obj i ≅ (Etale.upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (c.π.app (op i))).obj ((Etale.lowerStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (c.π.app (op i))).obj F)) (ι : D ⟶ (Functor.const I).obj F), (∀ {i j : I} (f : i ⟶ j), (e i).inv ≫ D.map f ≫ (e j).hom = kunDescentPullPushTransition X c F f) ∧ (∀ i : I, ι.app i = (e i).hom ≫ (Etale.upperStarLowerStarAdjunction AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (c.π.app (op i))).counit.app F) ∧ Nonempty (IsColimit (Cocone.mk F ι))
